name: jev-chat-review
description: Automatically review completed Codex agent runs with Jev.

interface.shortDescription: Automatic advisory review after each Codex run.
interface.longDescription: After each completed Codex agent turn, Jev reviews the local conversation transcript and recorded tool activity. Requires your AI Gateway key; conversation data is sent to the provider and may incur charges. Includes local daily usage limits, German guidance, and an advisory result.
interface.defaultPrompt: Jev reviews each completed Codex run automatically and provides an advisory result.
